stem: If $X=\{2,-1\}$, find $X^2=X\times X$. Tap all the ordered pairs that belong to $X^2$.
solution: $X^2$ means $X\times X$: both projections come from X.
Pair 2 with each element of X: (2, 2), (2, -1).
Pair -1 with each element of X: (-1, 2), (-1, -1).

hints.text: $X^2$ is X crossed with itself. Take each element of X as the first projection and pair it with every element of X.

notes: Reversed-pairs cannot be told apart here because X×X is symmetric, so only missing-pairs is hinted.
